body_markdown:
GRAND RAPIDS, Mich., Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — UFP Industries
(Nasdaq: UFPI) will announce third quarter 2026 results after the market close on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.


A conference call to discuss these results will take place on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, hosted by Will Schwartz, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Mike Cole, Chief Financial Officer.


A live audio webcast of the call along with supporting materials can be accessed using the[following link](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788756-1&h=2016059293&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fsbot746e&a=following+link) or on the UFP Industries Investor Relations website ([www.ufpinvestor.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788756-1&h=13851394&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ufpinvestor.com%2F&a=www.ufpinvestor.com) ).


A replay of the call will be made available on the company’s website for at least 90 days.
